title: South African airtime, data, SMS and electricity APIs: guides and sample code
description:
Integration guides, field-by-field references and runnable sample code in 13 languages for two South African prepaid platforms from Freepaid Pty Ltd: the Freepaid Airtime API (SOAP, RPC/encoded) and the SIMcloud REST API for airtime, data, SMS, vouchers and prepaid electricity. Also covers the SIMcloud MCP server for AI assistants and a guide to buying prepaid electricity from code.

Each API folder ships a local mock server, so the samples can be built and tested offline with no account and no money. The samples are run against the mocks in CI. The PL/SQL and ABAP samples are written but not executed.
